description: Finding: `AuthConfig::is_dev_mode()` in `crates/imap/src/config.rs` (line 114-120) is missing an explanation of why it omits the `oidc_providers` and `client_certs` checks that reader's equivalent method (`crates/reader/src/config.rs` line 385-392) performs. A reviewer comparing the two implementations cannot tell whether the omission is intentional (IMAP has no OIDC/client-cert path) or a bug. The doc comment should say something like: 'Unlike the reader's AuthConfig, IMAP supports only password-based auth; there are no OIDC providers or client certificate entries to check.'
title: imap is_dev_mode() silent on absent oidc/client_certs fields
